lede: Smithville packs its season into one weekend of candy canes, CandyLand and a lighted parade, then follows with Santa at the library.
celebrates: Smithville Parks and Recreation starts the weekend on Friday evening with Candy Cane Quest at Heritage Park, where Santa drops thousands of candy canes for children ages 0 to 12. On Saturday the Smithville Chamber of Commerce brings back CandyLand, a downtown tradition that starts at the Smithville Activity Center on Main Street. Families can stay for the Lighted Christmas Parade and the lighting of the Mayor's Christmas Tree. Mid-Continent Public Library's Smithville branch adds a Santa and Mrs. Claus storytime on December 17.
facts: Heritage Park covers 16.77 acres and has two lighted baseball fields, a T-ball field and three soccer fields, according to a city Parks and Recreation post. The Smithville Activity Center is at 113 W Main Street. The Smithville Library branch is at 120 Richardson Street. The city's Friday Newsflash of November 13, 2026 lists Candy Cane Quest on December 4 as free.

faq: When is Candy Cane Quest in Smithville?

Candy Cane Quest is on Friday, December 4, 2026, at 6 pm at Heritage Park, 320 E Main Street. It is free for children ages 0 to 12 according to Smithville Parks and Recreation and the city's Newsflash.

CandyLand is a Smithville Chamber of Commerce holiday tradition in downtown Smithville. It runs from 1 to 5:30 pm on Saturday, December 5, starting at the Smithville Activity Center, 113 W Main Street.
What time is the Smithville Christmas parade?

The Lighted Christmas Parade typically starts at 6 pm on Saturday, December 5, followed by the lighting of the Mayor's Christmas Tree, according to the chamber. Confirm on the chamber's page before you go.
Is there a Santa storytime in Smithville?
Yes. Mid-Continent Public Library's Smithville branch has Santa and Mrs. Claus reading on Thursday, December 17, from 10:30 to 11:30 am. Registration is required.
